name: Mag_OS — Vine Certificate — Personal Vine Page

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT '{{$json.certificate_code}}'::text AS certificate_code, {{$json.input_valid}}::boolean AS input_valid)
SELECT input.input_valid,
  CASE WHEN input.input_valid THEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM vine_certificate_service.vines v WHERE v.certificate_code=input.certificate_code) ELSE false END AS found,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'certificate_code',v.certificate_code,'owner_name',v.owner_name,'vine_name',v.vine_name,
    'photo_link',v.photo_link,'status',v.status,'last_update',v.last_update,
    'updates',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('update_text',u.update_text,'photo_link',u.photo_link,'date',u.date) ORDER BY u.date DESC,u.created_at DESC) FROM vine_certificate_service.vine_updates u WHERE u.certificate_code=v.certificate_code),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) FROM vine_certificate_service.vines v WHERE v.certificate_code=input.certificate_code),'{}'::jsonb)::text AS vine_json
FROM input;
